header: From clock-in to the payroll file
lead: Every recorded minute passes through all four stages. This is the chain an auditor asks to see.
note: Every step is saved with a timestamp and a name. The trail is kept for seven years and can be exported at any time.

stages.title: Record
stages.text: The employee clocks in. The device signs the time and stores it if there is no network.

stages.title: Match
stages.text: The time is compared with the planned shift. Any difference above the tolerance is flagged.

stages.title: Approve
stages.text: The manager confirms or corrects the time. A correction keeps both values and the reason.

stages.title: Export
stages.text: Approved minutes are totalled per contract and written to the payroll file at month end.
